verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Copilot turning user data into insights: Copilot in Excel and Analyst turn raw data into insights, connectors let Copilot find, summarize and act on OneDrive/Gmail/Outlook data, and code execution produces calculations and graphs. Copilot also proactively generates personalized suggestions from memory and past queries, and one community user praises how it fetches data across 365 documents. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how insights are generated (the docs are mostly marketing one-liners), and broader independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
